- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The best way to store potatoes is to keep them in a cool, dry, and dark place with good ventilation.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Storing potatoes in the refrigerator is not recommended because the cold temperature can convert potato starch into sugar, adversely affecting taste and texture.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The best way to store potatoes is to keep them in a cool, dry, and dark place with good ventilation, such as a pantry or a cellar.
